sql: SELECT c.bot_step, c.bot_enabled, c.bot_paused_until, c.bot_paused_reason, c.bot_paused_at, left(c.bot_data::text, 400) AS bot_data, (SELECT enabled FROM ai_agent_settings a WHERE a.company_id = w.company_id) AS ia_ligada, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-10-17T15:50:30Z' AND '2026-10-17T15:54:00Z') AS msgs_no_intervalo FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '5511996472316%'
